hardwareHubs.note: Home to Freeside Atlanta and Georgia Tech's CREATE-X startup programs.
The Garage makerspace is part of the Georgia Cyber Innovation and Training Center.

makerspaces.name: Freeside Atlanta
makerspaces.note: Volunteer-run nonprofit with tools for electronics, 3D printing, woodworking and metalworking.

makerspaces.name: Cherokee Makerspace
makerspaces.note: A June 2024 Georgia Magazine feature lists a plasma cutter, large CNC machines, a machine shop, laser cutters and 3D printers.

programs.name: Georgia Tech CREATE-X
programs.note: Offers prototyping grants through Idea to Prototype and Startup Launch with $5,000 seed funding and $30,000 in services, for students, faculty and alumni.

specialties.name: Automotive and electric mobility
specialties.note: Led by the Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America EV facility.

specialties.name: Aerospace and defense
specialties.note: Added over 1,500 new jobs in the first half of fiscal year 2023.

specialties.name: Food processing

support.name: Georgia Manufacturing Extension Partnership (GaMEP)
support.note: Georgia's NIST MEP center at Georgia Tech, working through ten regions with coaching and education for manufacturers.
